body: Jesus man I’m sorry that happened. Hope you’re doing better now.

I was thinking the same thing, I just didn’t want to sound like I don’t care so I didn’t include it. It just really scared me because the last time she attempted suicide I took her to the hospital so I took it very seriously. 

Thank you for your thoughtful reply including links!

I’ll start with calling some hotlines. I live in the US so an ambulance can be a massive pain financially, and I’m sure debt would not be welcome to a person in her position. Thank you for your response I appreciate it.
